import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim
import torch4ms
from torch4ms.autograd.ms_autograd_function import extract_and_wrap_loss_fn
from torch4ms.optim import Torch4msOptimizer


class ShiftedResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.path = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.relu(x + self.path(x))


class PocketResNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.block = ShiftedResidual(8)
        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(8, 6)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.block(torch.relu(self.stem(x)))
        return self.fc(self.pool(x).flatten(1))


def build_model(params=None):
    return PocketResNet()


def train_one_step(model, x, y, lr=8e-4):
    base_optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)

    env = torch4ms.default_env()

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss_wrapper = extract_and_wrap_loss_fn(model, criterion, x, y)
        loss = loss_wrapper.output
        loss.backward(module=model)
        optimizer.step()
        loss_value = float(loss.detach().item())
    return loss_value

import math

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

import torch4ms
from torch4ms.autograd.ms_autograd_function import extract_and_wrap_loss_fn
from torch4ms.optim import Torch4msOptimizer


class CompactAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab=41, width=20, classes=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab, width)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(width, width * 3)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(width, width)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(width)
        self.head = nn.Linear(width, classes)
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(width)

    def forward(self, tokens):
        hidden = self.embed(tokens)
        q, k, v = self.qkv(hidden).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        weights = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale, dim=-1)
        hidden = self.norm(hidden + self.proj(torch.matmul(weights, v)))
        return self.head(hidden.mean(dim=1))


def build_model(params=None):
    return CompactAttentionClassifier()


def train_one_step(model, x, y, lr=1e-3):
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    env = torch4ms.default_env()
    with env:
        base_optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
        optimizer = Torch4msOptimizer(base_optimizer, model)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss_wrapper = extract_and_wrap_loss_fn(model, criterion, x, y)
        loss = loss_wrapper.output
        loss.backward(module=model)
        optimizer.step()
        return float(loss.detach().item())
